genitals noun

also genitalia, private parts, privates, sexual organs

classical

Cels. 4.1; Quint. 1.6.36; Juv. 6.514 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 58, 320

genitālia, genitālium n. pl.

noun, third declension, plural · Declension on Wiktionary

the genitals

The neuter of genitālis, generative, used as a noun (membra understood): the plain anatomical word, of either sex.

  • virīlia, virīlium n. pl. — a male’s private parts

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Traupman 58 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • muliebria, muliebrium n. pl. — a female’s private parts

    noun, third declension, plural · also used · classical · Tac. Ann. 14.60; Traupman 58, 320 · Declension on Wiktionary
